replies.author: Zedther
replies.body:
It's a 9 block gap, all you have to do is go out 4 blocks and block place if you're trying to rush..
Personally, I am not a fan of easy rush maps, maps that are harder to rush on are better, as they eject a more intensive gameplay. Similar to the concept of World Tree.
In addition, how does a gap mess up defense, people can easily just bridge themselves and fill up the gap.
